name: Pointer
description: Are you tired of calculating your CGPA on broken apps, Tracking your Marks on complicated sheets, searching for Resource links, trying to build a timetable or to find reviews about the Next Electives you plan to take?. Join Pointer: An all in One Academics Manager, and a lovely community of BITSians. Designed by a BITSian, for BITSians.

paragraphs: Pointer is an all-in-one academics manager, and a lovely community of BITSians. Your grades, marks, timetable, reviews and resources, in one app that works offline. For BITS Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad.
Built with Flutter (web) and Firebase. The code is public, free for non-commercial use under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. Maintained by Siddharth Mishra (@e-iotapi).
features: Five tabs, three spreadsheets, one tired BITSian. Pointer is one app for all of it.

Pick your discipline and batch, single or dual degree, and every core course is laid out semester by semester from the official charts. Tap a grade and your SGPA and CGPA move with it, with every BITS rule for NC, RC, W…

Pointer reads the campus timetable and puts your courses in, section and all. Your midsems and compres land on their own, classes pause for exam weeks, and every dated evaluative you enter in Marks shows up too.
Quizzes, labs, the midsem and the compre, each with its parts and best-of-n rules. Courses out of 300 rescale to 100 on their own, and the class average sits right beside your score.
Anonymous reviews of every course, from the batches before you. Know how it is graded, whether the slides are enough and if the exams are open book, before you register.

whatItDoes.text: Pointer is an all-in-one academics manager, and a lovely community of BITSians. Your grades, marks, timetable, reviews and resources, in one app that works offline. For BITS Pilani, Goa and Hyderabad.

requirements.text: Sign in on a laptop and your grades are already there.
The beta is served from the same address as the stable app, so it shares the student's sign-in and the same production data.
